view.sqlSentence: SELECT @ini:=(SELECT IF (SUM(inventory_detail.cost) IS NULL, 0, SUM(inventory_detail.cost * inventory_detail.actual_quantity)) FROM inventory, inventory_detail, item, product, pcategory, pcategory_group WHERE item.product = product.id AND product.category = pcategory.id AND pcategory.pcategory_group = pcategory_group.id AND inventory_detail.item = item.id AND inventory.id = inventory_detail.inventory AND pcategory_group.id = ? AND inventory.inventory_date = ?) AS inicial, @com:=(SELECT IF (SUM(invoice_detail.taxable_base) IS NULL, 0, SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2))) FROM invoice_detail, invoice, item, product, pcategory, invoice_tax, pcategory_group WHERE item.product = product.id AND product.category = pcategory.id AND pcategory.pcategory_group = pcategory_group.id AND invoice_detail.item = item.id AND invoice_detail.invoice = invoice.id AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND invoice.type = 0 AND pcategory_group.id = ? AND invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ?) AS compras, @ven:=(SELECT IF (SUM(invoice_detail.taxable_base) IS NULL, 0, SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2))) FROM invoice_detail, invoice, item, product, pcategory, invoice_tax, pcategory_group WHERE item.product = product.id AND product.category = pcategory.id AND pcategory.pcategory_group = pcategory_group.id AND invoice_detail.item = item.id AND invoice_detail.invoice = invoice.id AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND invoice.type = 1 AND pcategory_group.id = ? AND invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ?) AS ventas, @fin:=(SELECT IF (SUM(inventory_detail.cost) IS NULL, 0, SUM(inventory_detail.cost * inventory_detail.actual_quantity)) FROM inventory, inventory_detail, item, product, pcategory, pcategory_group WHERE item.product = product.id AND product.category = pcategory.id AND pcategory.pcategory_group = pcategory_group.id AND inventory_detail.item = item.id AND inventory.id = inventory_detail.inventory AND pcategory_group.id = ? AND inventory.inventory_date = ?) AS final, @ben:=(@ini + @ven - @fin - @com) AS beneficio, ((@ben / @com) * 100) AS sobre_compras, ((@ben / @ven) * 100) AS sobre_ventas
